shortDescription: Manages the RADIUS server configuration of the device

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the RADIUS server.

options.name: ip
options.description: The IP address of the server. This parameter is mandatory when creating a new resource.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the RADIUS server to manage.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the server. Valid range of values is between C(0) and C(65535) inclusive.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: secret
options.description: Specifies the secret used for accessing RADIUS server. This parameter is mandatory when creating a new resource.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(state) is C(present), ensures the RADIUS server exists. When C(state) is C(absent), ensures the RADIUS server is removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the timeout value in seconds. Valid range of values is between C(1) and C(60) inclusive.

options.name: update_secret
options.description: C(always) will update passwords if the C(secret) is specified. C(on_create) will only set the password for newly created servers.
